scripts.build: pnpm --filter @blendsdk/year-planner-core build && pnpm --filter @blendsdk/react-year-planner build && pnpm --filter @blendsdk/year-planner-languages build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @blendsdk/year-planner-core build && pnpm --filter @blendsdk/react-year-planner build && pnpm --filter @blendsdk/year-planner-languages build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.api-report: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @blendsdk/year-planner-core api-report && pnpm --filter @blendsdk/react-year-planner api-report
